# Vendored PartCAD schemas

Source: https://github.com/partcad/partcad/tree/354ed5201e831b867ce0eb9637a234ea3f3ec692
Release: 0.8.232. The JSON schemas and LICENSE.txt are unmodified upstream files.
UPSTREAM.json records their original paths and SHA-256 checksums.

The schemas describe YAML-parsed data and also validate equivalent JSON objects.
This project uses only the literal subset documented in docs/catalogs.md.
No PartCAD runtime code is imported.
